meaning.tr: bir şeyden çok etkilenmek, hayran kalmak (olumlu şaşkınlık)

equivalent.tr: büyülenmek, çok etkilenmek, ağzı açık kalmak
equivalent.de: überwältigt sein, umgehauen sein, begeistert sein

literal.en: to be swept away by the wind

usage.en: be blown away (by sth) → the one impressed. sth blows sb away → the impressive thing. Unlike blow up, here the passive does carry the emotional meaning.
usage.tr: be blown away (by sth) → etkilenen. sth blows sb away → etkileyen. Blow up'ın tersine burada edilgen yapı duygu anlamı taşır.

sentences.en: I was [blown away] by how good the food was.
sentences.tr: Yemeklerin bu kadar iyi olmasına hayran kaldım.
sentences.de: Ich war überwältigt, wie gut das Essen war.

sentences.en: Her performance just [blew me away].
sentences.de: Ihr Auftritt hat mich einfach umgehauen.

meaning.en: to be startled by an unexpected remark or behaviour (usually mildly negative)
meaning.tr: beklenmedik bir söz/davranış karşısında afallamak (çoğunlukla hafif olumsuz)
meaning.de: von einer unerwarteten Bemerkung oder einem Verhalten überrascht sein (meist leicht negativ)

equivalent.de: verblüfft sein, verdutzt sein, vor den Kopf gestoßen sein

usage.en: Almost always passive: be taken aback (by sth). ✗ taken back (that is different: to be returned / to be reminded of the past).
usage.tr: Neredeyse hep edilgen: be taken aback (by sth). ✗ taken back (o başka: geri götürülmek/geçmişi hatırlamak).

collocations.en: a bit / somewhat / completely taken aback
collocations.tr: a bit / somewhat / completely taken aback

sentences.en: I was a bit [taken aback] by how rude he was.
sentences.tr: Bu kadar kaba olmasına biraz afalladım.
sentences.de: Ich war etwas verblüfft, wie unhöflich er war.

sentences.en: She seemed [taken aback] when I asked about her ex.
sentences.de: Sie wirkte verdutzt, als ich nach ihrem Ex fragte.

meaning.en: to surprise someone who is not prepared
meaning.de: jemanden überraschen, der nicht vorbereitet ist

literal.en: to catch someone with their guard down

usage.en: sth catches sb off guard · be caught off guard (by sth)
usage.tr: sth catches sb off guard · be caught off guard (by sth)

sentences.en: The question totally [caught me off guard].
sentences.de: Die Frage hat mich völlig kalt erwischt.

sentences.en: I was [caught off guard] when she started crying.
sentences.de: Ich war überrumpelt, als sie anfing zu weinen.

meaning.en: to express surprise, admiration or reproach
meaning.tr: şaşkınlık, hayranlık ya da sitem bildirmek

equivalent.de: es nicht fassen können, es nicht glauben können

usage.en: I can't believe (that) + clause · I can't believe it! · "I can't believe you did that." (often reproach) · unbelievable
usage.tr: I can't believe (that) + cümle · I can't believe it! · "I can't believe you did that." (çoğu zaman sitem) · unbelievable

sentences.en: I [can't believe] she actually said that to your face.
sentences.de: Ich kann nicht fassen, dass sie dir das wirklich ins Gesicht gesagt hat.

sentences.en: I [can't believe] it's already November.
sentences.de: Ich kann nicht glauben, dass schon November ist.

meaning.en: to be unable to find words from surprise (or anger)
meaning.tr: şaşkınlıktan (ya da öfkeden) söyleyecek söz bulamamak
meaning.de: vor Überraschung (oder Wut) keine Worte finden

equivalent.de: sprachlos sein, jemandem fehlen die Worte

usage.en: be/be left speechless · synonyms: be lost for words (BrE) / at a loss for words (AmE)
usage.tr: be/be left speechless · eşanlamlı: be lost for words (BrE) / at a loss for words (AmE)

sentences.en: When they announced my name, I was [speechless].
sentences.de: Als sie meinen Namen aufriefen, war ich sprachlos.

sentences.en: Honestly, I'm [speechless]. I don't even know what to say to that.
sentences.tr: Vallahi dilim tutuldu, buna ne denir bilmiyorum.
sentences.de: Ehrlich, ich bin sprachlos. Ich weiß gar nicht, was ich dazu sagen soll.

meaning.en: to be surprised to a shaking degree
meaning.de: so überrascht sein, dass es einen erschüttert

usage.en: be shocked (by/at sth · to hear · that …) → the reaction. be in shock → a state whose effect still lasts. shocking = causing shock. Slang: "I'm shook."
usage.tr: be shocked (by/at sth · to hear · that …) → tepki. be in shock → etkisi hâlâ süren hâl. shocking = şoke edici. Argo: "I'm shook."

sentences.en: I'm still [in shock] — I really didn't expect to win.
sentences.de: Ich stehe immer noch unter Schock – ich habe wirklich nicht erwartet zu gewinnen.

sentences.en: I was [shocked] at how much weight he'd lost.
sentences.tr: Ne kadar kilo verdiğini görünce şoke oldum.
sentences.de: Ich war geschockt, wie viel er abgenommen hatte.

meaning.en: (1) disbelief: "That can't be true!" (2) flat refusal: "Absolutely not."
meaning.de: (1) Unglaube: „Das kann nicht wahr sein!“ (2) klare Ablehnung: „Auf keinen Fall.“

equivalent.tr: Yok artık! Hadi canım! / Asla, hayatta olmaz
equivalent.de: Echt jetzt? Das gibt's doch nicht! / Auf keinen Fall. Vergiss es.

usage.en: An exclamation on its own. Also: "There's no way + clause" = it's impossible that.
usage.tr: Tek başına ünlem. Ayrıca: "There's no way + cümle" = imkânı yok.

sentences.en: "They're getting married." "[No way]! Since when?"
sentences.de: „Sie heiraten.“ „Das gibt's doch nicht! Seit wann?“

sentences.en: "Can you lend me 500 euros?" "[No way]."
sentences.de: „Kannst du mir 500 Euro leihen?“ „Auf keinen Fall.“

meaning.en: to show that you can't believe what you've heard
meaning.de: zeigen, dass man nicht glauben kann, was man gehört hat

equivalent.de: Das ist nicht dein Ernst! Du machst Witze!

variety.en: kidding: AmE + BrE (more common in AmE) · joking: more common in BrE
variety.tr: kidding: AmE + BrE (AmE'de daha sık) · joking: BrE'de daha sık

usage.en: "You're kidding." (surprise) · "You've got to be kidding me." (usually annoyed disbelief) · "No kidding!" = (1) really? (2) ironic: "as if anyone didn't know"
usage.tr: "You're kidding." (şaşkınlık) · "You've got to be kidding me." (çoğu zaman sinirli inanamama) · "No kidding!" = (1) gerçekten mi? (2) ironik: "bunu bilmeyen mi var"

sentences.en: "I quit my job today." "[You're kidding]. Seriously?"
sentences.de: „Ich habe heute gekündigt.“ „Du machst Witze. Im Ernst?“

sentences.en: The train's cancelled again? You've got to be [kidding me].
sentences.tr: Tren yine mi iptal? Dalga geçiyor olmalılar.
sentences.de: Der Zug fällt schon wieder aus? Das ist doch nicht euer Ernst.

meaning.en: not to expect something at all

equivalent.de: etwas nicht kommen sehen, mit etwas nicht rechnen

usage.en: didn't see it/that coming · should have seen it coming (it was obvious, really)
usage.tr: didn't see it/that coming · should have seen it coming (belliydi aslında)

sentences.en: They broke up? Wow, I did not [see that coming].
sentences.tr: Ayrıldılar mı? Vay, bunu hiç beklemiyordum.
sentences.de: Sie haben sich getrennt? Wow, damit habe ich nicht gerechnet.

sentences.en: Looking back, I should have [seen it coming].
sentences.de: Im Nachhinein hätte ich es kommen sehen müssen.

equivalent.tr: durup dururken, pat diye, hiç yoktan
equivalent.de: aus heiterem Himmel, wie aus dem Nichts

literal.en: out of the clear blue sky (like a sudden bolt of lightning)

usage.en: Adverbial phrase; usually at the end of the clause. "completely out of the blue".
usage.tr: Zarf öbeği; genellikle cümle sonunda. "completely out of the blue".

collocations.en: call/text sb out of the blue · It came out of the blue.
collocations.tr: call/text sb out of the blue · It came out of the blue.

sentences.en: My ex texted me [out of the blue] last night.
sentences.tr: Eski sevgilim dün gece durup dururken mesaj attı.
sentences.de: Mein Ex hat mir gestern Abend aus heiterem Himmel geschrieben.

sentences.en: He just quit, completely [out of the blue].
sentences.tr: Pat diye istifa etti, hiç beklenmedik biçimde.
sentences.de: Er hat einfach gekündigt, völlig aus heiterem Himmel.

equivalent.tr: şaşkına dönmek, ağzı açık kalmak, küçük dilini yutmak
equivalent.de: baff sein, platt sein, sprachlos sein

literal.en: floored = knocked to the floor · gob (mouth) + smacked (slapped)
literal.tr: floored = yere serilmiş · gob (ağız) + smacked (şaplak yemiş)

usage.en: be floored/gobsmacked (by sth / when …). Intensified with absolutely.
usage.tr: be floored/gobsmacked (by sth / when …). absolutely ile güçlendirilir.

sentences.en: I was [floored] when I saw the price.
sentences.de: Ich war baff, als ich den Preis gesehen habe.

sentences.en: I was absolutely [gobsmacked] when she told me how old she was.
sentences.de: Ich war völlig platt, als sie mir sagte, wie alt sie ist.

meaning.en: (of news or a fact) to be slowly understood and felt
meaning.de: (von einer Nachricht oder Tatsache) langsam begriffen und gefühlt werden

equivalent.tr: kafasına dank etmek, idrak etmek, içine sinmek
equivalent.de: sacken, bei jemandem ankommen, etwas realisieren

literal.en: to sink into, to be absorbed

usage.en: Subject = the news/fact: "It hasn't sunk in yet." ✗ I haven't sunk in. · "Let that sink in." (think about that for a moment)
usage.tr: Özne = haber/gerçek: "It hasn't sunk in yet." ✗ I haven't sunk in. · "Let that sink in." (bunu bir düşün)

sentences.en: I got the job, but it still hasn't [sunk in].
sentences.tr: İşi aldım ama hâlâ tam idrak edemedim.
sentences.de: Ich habe den Job bekommen, aber ich habe es noch gar nicht realisiert.

sentences.en: It took a few days for the news to [sink in].
sentences.de: Es hat ein paar Tage gedauert, bis die Nachricht gesackt war.
